calibration.P1_definition: Unchanged inherited query_readout(prepared query, native-coordinate state error).square().mean; no new normalization invented
calibration.aggregation: Equal arithmetic mean of the two window scores; all18 KDA layers and all16 heads
calibration.recurrence_note: Original L7 already H128 recurrent-aware; matched deployment application is not replay of historical 512-token training sampling

dataset_identity.reencoding: Historical frozen exact reencoding evidence rehashed; not re-tokenized during this audit
dataset_identity.upstream_dataset_revision: NOT_PRESENT_IN_AUDITED_FREEZE; not inferred from folder date
dataset_identity.version_basis: Local phase3_mixed_hardware_v1_20261003 snapshot paths plus exact raw/token content SHA256

frozen_selection.aggregation: equal mean of the two frozen windows
frozen_selection.primary: mean full-vocabulary FP32 KL(FP||student) on token positions [8192,32768)
frozen_selection.selection_rule: opposite sign, both complete-roster midrank gaps>=3, descending min-gap then ordered scientific-key lexicographic tie-break

leakage_audit.caveat: Cannot prove all undocumented human/file-access history; claims limited to frozen code, receipts, inventories and audit evidence
leakage_audit.selector_static_inputs: Only complete short calibration, frozen rules/route, source identities, accounting and input metadata
